columns.validationmsg: "Item flat Disc should be greater than zero"
columns.name: itemflatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Claimable Discount % value should be between 0 and 100'
columns.name: claimablediscperc

columns.validationmsg: 'Pack Qty should be greater than or equal to zero'
columns.name: packqtyforsale

columns.validationmsg: 'Bonus Qty should be greater than or equal to zero'
columns.name: bonuspackqtyforsale

columns.validationmsg: 'Qty should be greater than or equal to zero'
columns.name: bonusqty

columns.validationmsg: 'Bonus Qty should be greater than or equal to zero'
columns.name: looseqty

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	item.customicode, 
	itemname= item.name, 
	locksaleprice = dbo.item.locksaleprice,
	lockdiscperc = dbo.item.lockdiscperc,
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock     = 0.0000, 
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	qtysale=item.saleqty,
	bonus=item.bonusqty,
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	purprice=0.00,
	recentpurprice=0.00,
	avgprice=saleinvdetail.avgprice,
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	assgcode  = 1, 
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	saleinvdetail.saleinvcode,   
	saleinvdetail.icode,   
	saleinvdetail.gcode,
	saleinvdetail.batch,
	saleinvdetail.expiry,
	saleinvdetail.saleutn,
	itemflatdisc = saleinvdetail.itemflatdisc,
	saleinvdetail.IDENTITYCOL, 
	packunits = saleinvdetail.packunits,
	saleprice = saleinvdetail.saleprice,
	rate      = saleinvdetail.rate,
	SaleItemDescription =  saleinvdetail.SaleItemDescription,
	DescICode =  saleinvdetail.DescICode,
	discperc  = saleinvdetail.discperc,
	saleinvdetail.salerowid,
	saleinvdetail.issuerowid,
	saleinvdetail.sourcesaleinvcode,
	itemcode = 0,
	retailprice=item.retailprice,
	rowgroup=saleinvdetail.rowgroup,
	packprice = saleinvdetail.packprice,
	unitsalestax=saleinvdetail.unitsalestax,
	alternatepurprice=saleinvdetail.alternatepurprice,
	UnitWeight = item.UnitWeight,
	PackingFactor = item.PackingFactor,
	Claimable = SaleInvDetail.Claimable,
	ClaimableDiscPerc = SaleInvDetail.ClaimableDiscPerc,
	gstperc=saleinvdetail.gstperc,
	packqtyforsale = saleinvdetail.packqtyforsale, 
	bonuspackqtyforsale = saleinvdetail.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	bonusqty=saleinvdetail.bonusqty,
	looseqty= saleinvdetail.looseqty 

FROM  saleinvdetail,   
		item 

WHERE ( dbo.saleinvdetail.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND
		( saleinvdetail.icode = item.icode )
	  
ORDER BY saleinvdetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum( ( ( looseqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc )) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.expression: sum( round( unitsalestax  * (Bonusqty + looseqty) ,2)  for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: sum( round( c_itemtotal  *  gstperc * 0.01,2)  for all)

objects.name: c_sumclaimablevalue
objects.expression: sum(if( claimable = 'Y', looseqty * saleprice *  claimablediscperc * 0.01, 0) for all)
